# owner: platform
"""Absence notices for parents."""

from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


def _check_owner(student: Student, marks: list) -> None:
    for mark in marks:
        if mark.student_id != student.student_id:
            raise ProjectError(f"mark for {mark.student_id} given for {student.student_id}")


def absence_notice(student: Student, marks: list) -> str:
    """Short notice naming the student, the days missed and the dates."""
    _check_owner(student, marks)
    days = sorted(mark.day for mark in marks if mark.status == "absent")
    if not days:
        raise ProjectError(f"no absences for {student.student_id}")
    dates = ", ".join(item.isoformat() for item in days)
    name = f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name}"
    return f"{name} missed {len(days)} day(s) of school: {dates}."
EOF
cat > tests/test_notices.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
import unittest
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from datetime import date

PUPIL = Student("s1", "Doe", "Jane", "A")


def make_mark(ident, day, status):
    return Mark(ident, date(2026, 9, day), status)


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_dates_in_order(self):
        marks = [make_mark("s1", 4, "absent"), make_mark("s1", 2, "absent"), make_mark("s1", 3, "present")]
        text = absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        self.assertEqual(text, "Jane Doe missed 2 day(s) of school: 2026-09-02, 2026-09-04.")

    def test_other_student(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, [make_mark("s2", 2, "absent")])

    def test_no_absences(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, [make_mark("s1", 2, "present")])
EOF
